sources.kind: candidate DWG/DXF reader and 2D renderer repository README/metadata
sources.finding: Claims self-developed MIT C++20 parsing for AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032, a limited entity set, JSON scene export, and regression_smoke; repository page lists main/100 commits and no release. Claims remain unverified because no build or parser run was performed.
Documents dynamic class dispatch for types 500 and above.

States R2000 has only fixed object types, conflicting with the candidate's own class-dispatch document and ODA's R13-R15 Classes section. Treat as documentation inconsistency, not a demonstrated source-code defect.

sources.kind: authoritative ODA DWG specification, section 10.1 R13-R15
sources.finding: The R13-R15 Classes section describes drawing-defined classes and their records, confirming that the candidate's R2000 fixed-only statement must not be used as a format fact.

Describes a zero-copy single-pass no_std binary-DXF scanner for AC1015+ with a limited typed-entity set and unknown-entity retention; repository page lists one commit and no release. ASCII conversion is delegated to another tool.

sources.kind: DWG/DXF application wrapper README and dependency route
sources.finding: Explicitly uses LibreDWG FFI for DWG and the undxf crate for DXF before mapping into a shared application model; therefore its DWG parse is not an independent parser vote.

sources.kind: public repository README and license notice
sources.finding: The project states it is pre-1.0 and its visible source is proprietary with no use/copy/modify/redistribute permission; it is DXF-only. Exclude it from open-source peer qualification and reuse.

existing_controls_confirmed: The plan already treats peer version badges, entity survival, parser lineage, and consumer projection as separate evidence dimensions.
The local repeated-DXF-record 20,000-item control and Turkish CP1254 route are already represented; the new candidate screen does not duplicate those local tasks.
The existing composed peer checkpoint can host optional candidate qualification without per-slice external runs.
